title: Husbands — Full-Film Cue Timing, Speaker and Pacing Index
status: ALL_1213_CUES_INDEXED — subtitle timing and text pacing proxies; join with source audio cue features
interpretation_limits: Cue display duration is not actual speech duration; VAD active duration in the audio cue feature file is the better acoustic estimate, but remains conservative and imperfect.
Subtitle gaps are not necessarily pauses in speech; phrase continuity can cross cue boundaries and silence can occur inside cues.
Display WPM is a pacing proxy only; do not directly use as final TTS speed without audio listening and phrase-level review.
Speaker profiles count cue assignments; they are not proof of voice identity or emotion.
